02Why solar

Before the generator,
there was the sun.

Between petrol prices and endless outages, a generator now costs more to run than it did to buy — and still leaves you in the dark when the fuel runs out. A properly sized solar system turns that monthly spend into clean power on your own roof, and quiet nights for your family.

See what we install
Completed install · Nigeria

Clean.Quiet.Always on.

03What we install

Everything your home needs
to run on sunlight.

01

Solar panels

High-efficiency monocrystalline panels, sized to your roof and your daytime demand, mounted to survive harmattan dust and rainy-season storms.

02

Hybrid inverters

The brain of the system. It runs your home on solar, charges the batteries, and draws from the grid only when it has to — switching so fast you never notice.

03

Battery storage

Lithium (LiFePO₄) or tubular banks that store the day's sun so your lights, fans and fridge stay on through the night and the next outage.

04

App monitoring

See how much power you're making, using and storing — live, from your phone. Know your system is working before you even look up at the roof.

05

Service & maintenance

Scheduled cleaning, health checks and support. We installed it, so we keep it running — you just enjoy the quiet.

04Who we power

Different homes. Different loads.
The same need for steady light.

01.

Flats & self-contained

Lights, fans, TV and phones kept on through the night, without the noise or fumes of a small generator in the compound.

02.

Family homes & duplexes

Fridge, freezer, pump and a room of AC running on solar, with batteries sized for a full night of backup.

03.

Estates & small offices

Whole-building systems with lithium banks and all-day backup, so work and life never stop when the grid does.

08How we work

From first call to
first light.

01

Size it

Use the calculator, or book a free audit. We work out exactly how much power your home needs.

02

Quote it

A clear, itemised quote — panels, inverter, batteries and installation. No hidden extras.

03

Install it

Our certified crew mounts, wires and commissions the system, usually in one to two days.

04

Support it

Monitor from your phone. We handle servicing, so your power just keeps running.
